brief: Create a square original editorial poster for a reusable bottle named STILL. Exact headline: "A quieter everyday." Exact bottle label: "STILL". One bottle only, no other words or logos. Large legible headline, generous margins. Use the reference images only for assigned visual properties; do not copy their words or subjects.

composition.description: An asymmetrical layout: two-line headline at middle left, large bottle at right, generous space above.
